title: Code of Conduct
strapline: Playing Fair, Staying Kind, and Making Netball Fun For All
intro: We want every session to be positive, inclusive, and enjoyable whether you're brand new to netball or a seasoned pro. Our code of conduct sets out a few key expectations for players, parents, and spectators so we can all support a respectful, friendly environment on and off the court.

sections.heading: Players
items: Respect every player, umpire, coach, and spectator, whatever the score.
Play to the rules and accept the umpire's decisions without argument.
Keep language and behaviour appropriate. Abuse, bullying, and discrimination have no place at Momentum.
Arrive on time, in suitable kit and non-marking trainers, ready to warm up.
Look after the venue, the equipment, and each other. Report injuries or hazards to the organiser straight away.
Shake hands and thank your opponents and umpire after every match.

sections.heading: Captains
items: Make sure your team knows and follows this code.
Confirm your team's attendance and let us know as early as possible if you cannot field a team.
Be the first point of contact for the umpire and the organiser on match night.
Raise concerns with the organiser calmly, away from the court.

sections.heading: Parents and spectators
items: Encourage every player on both teams. Applaud good play wherever it comes from.
Never shout at, criticise, or coach from the sideline. Leave the umpiring to the umpire.
Stay off the court and out of the team areas during play.
Set the example you would want the players to follow.

sections.heading: Safeguarding and wellbeing
items: Momentum Netball follows England Netball safeguarding guidance. Every coach and umpire is expected to keep players safe.
If you see or experience anything that worries you, tell the organiser on the night or email hello@momentumnetball.co.uk.
Concerns are handled in confidence and taken seriously.

sections.heading: If the code is broken
items: The organiser or umpire may issue a warning, ask a player to sit out, or ask a spectator to leave.
Repeated or serious breaches can lead to suspension from the league without refund, as set out in our Terms and Conditions.

closing: Thank you for helping us keep Momentum a place where everyone can enjoy their netball.
